title: Fix Representation (Optimally) Before Fairness: Finite-Sample Shrinkage Population Correction and the True Price of Fairness Under Subpopulation Shift
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical and statistical aspects of algorithmic fairness, specifically addressing how subpopulation shifts impact fairness-utility tradeoffs. While fairness is a component of AI ethics, the paper does not benchmark or evaluate religion, faith, or specific moral/philosophical systems beyond technical fairness metrics like demographic parity.
